$comment: Generated from OutTurn in ../agents/dist/out/types.d.ts by `pnpm schema:update`; don't edit. One line of a session's turns.jsonl in its out directory.
title: OutTurn

CostUsd.description: A dollar figure and where it came from.

basis.description: `reported`: what the harness (Claude Code, pi) or the gateway (OpenRouter) said it cost; `estimated`: the tokens at list prices, which leave out discounts, and long-prompt rates where a model call's own tokens, or the price's tiers, aren't known.

source.description: Who reported it (`claude-code`, `pi`, `openrouter`, `fake`), or the prices it was estimated at (`models.dev 2026-11-05`, a `REEVAL_PRICES` file); several, joined with `, `, in a sum.

OutTurn.description: One line of `turns.jsonl`: a turn's result, less its trajectory, raw parts and steps.

agentMs.description: The turn's agent time, recorded in place of the wall clock around `send`; only a scripted harness sets it.

agentUsage.description: The agent's own share of `usage`, without its subagents'; null when the harness reports only a total that can't be split. Set only on a turn that spawned a subagent.

cost.description: What the harness said the turn cost, when it says.

model.description: The model the harness says served the turn; null when it reports none.

providerStop.description: When the model provider, not the agent, ended the turn: the run is then an infra error.

reasoningMs.description: Milliseconds the agent spent reasoning in the turn, from the reasoning blocks it streamed; null when the harness can't time its reasoning, and absent for a scripted harness, whose reasoning events carry their own durations.

rejectedKey.description: The turn's error, naming the variable, when the model API rejected the harness's credential: the run is then an infra error, not the agent's failure.

subagents.description: The subagents the turn spawned, in spawn order.

subagentUsage.description: Whether `usage` counts the turn's subagents; set only on a turn that spawned one.

text.description: The agent's final message for the turn.

turn.description: The turn's index in the session, from 0.

unreported.description: Event types the harness can't report, so their absence from `trajectory` proves nothing.

usage.description: Tokens the turn used, when the harness reports them, its subagents' included.

ProviderStop.description: A turn the model provider stopped, with the message to fail the turn's run with.

SubagentRun.description: One subagent a turn spawned, from its spawn call and what its CLI stored.

agent.description: The kind of agent it ran (Claude Code's `subagent_type`).

background.description: Set when it ran in the background while its spawner went on.

durationMs.description: Its wall time; null when unknown.

events.description: How its own events reached the trajectory: `streamed` with its spawner's, or `none`, so only the spawn call and its result are there (the workspace diff has what it changed).

finalMessage.description: Its last message, from the spawn call's result.

id.description: The spawn call's `toolCallId`, which its events' `subagent` names.

model.description: The model it ran on, as its harness names it.

nativeId.description: The harness's own id for it: Claude Code's agent id, Codex's thread id, Cursor's agent id.

parent.description: The spawning subagent's `id`, for a subagent another spawned.

status.description: How it ended; null when the turn ended first or the harness doesn't say.

usage.description: Its own model calls' tokens, its own subagents' left out; null when they can't be read.

TokenUsage.description: The tokens one turn used, as its harness reported them. `input` excludes cache reads and writes (so the prompt was `input + cacheRead + cacheWrite`); `reasoning` is part of `output`.

WebEventType.description: The trajectory events a harness may be unable to report.
